title.zh-CN: 持续黄疸伴淡色便 · 2月龄男婴
title.en: Persistent jaundice and pale stools · boy aged two months

summary.zh-CN: 代谢性胆汁淤积证据与胆道结构异常可以并存，单一基因结果不应中止梗阻评估。
summary.en: Metabolic cholestasis and structural biliary disease can coexist; genetic results should not end obstruction assessment.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 长期肝功能、营养和生存结局，以及HBsAg后续核实。
unknowns.en: Long-term hepatic, nutritional and survival outcomes and follow-up of HBsAg positivity.

references: 童凡, 杨建滨, 黄晓磊, 周雪莲, 杨茹莱. citrin缺陷致新生儿肝内胆汁淤积症合并先天性胆道闭锁一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(11):863-865. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.11.013.

testUtterances.text: 生后第几天开始黄，后来有减轻吗？
On which day did jaundice begin, and has it improved?
皮肤和眼白是不是越来越黄？
Have the skin and eyes become more yellow?
大便是什么颜色，小便是不是很黄？
What colour are stools, and is urine dark yellow?
有没有完全白色大便？
Have stools ever been completely white?
吃奶和精神怎样？
How are feeding and alertness?
平时母乳和奶粉怎么喂？
How is breast and formula feeding arranged?
之前治疗一周后黄疸退了吗？
Did jaundice improve after the earlier week of treatment?
最早什么时候因为黄疸住院？
When was the first admission for jaundice?
出生和早期发育情况怎样？
How were birth and early development?
生长和发育是否跟得上同龄孩子？
Have growth and development kept up with peers?
家里有人有类似疾病或遗传病吗？
Does anyone in the family have similar or inherited illness?
父母和兄弟姐妹健康情况怎样？
How is the health of parents and siblings?
疫苗按时接种了吗？
Were vaccinations given on schedule?
能查到预防接种记录吗？
Are vaccination records available?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
以前有没有既往健康情况方面的情况？
Could you describe any previous health?
